note: Machine-readable capability map. Provider chains are ordered: first reachable entry wins; a non-first hit reports 'degraded'. probe.type: command (PATH lookup, then probe.fallback_globs), skill-dir / path (filesystem; `{plugin}` = this package's own root), python-import (imports the module under the interpreter the state CLI runs in), conversation (must be verified in-session, cannot be probed offline), always (built into the host). on_missing.action: degrade (use registered fallback, record degraded), blocker (raise a state blocker, continue other work), stop (phase cannot proceed).
